long_biography.plain_text:
Rätsepp entered Estonia’s emerging capital markets as a founding member of Balti Cresco Investment Group and helped establish the Tallinn Stock Exchange. He later co-founded Alta Capital, then built his own holding and investment companies. His work has included arranging capital for Baltic businesses, leading initial public offerings and financing ownership transactions.

Through Renergy and Sarto Holding, Rätsepp developed a portfolio across industry, property, forestry and energy, including a long-term investment in wood-pellet producer Graanul Invest. He now leads Sarto Capital, where his public role combines company-building with private-market and public-market investment. His education spans the University of Tartu, Stockholm School of Economics, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and NYU Stern.
